notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Two searches and about seven page reads found no build date, builder, staffing, fire history or current status. Everything footnoted comes from the tower list (name, county, coordinates), a Pastmaps index of a 2011 USGS topo map (tower shown as a landmark), OpenStreetMap (named point) and Wikipedia (Uwharrie context, not about the tower). A TikTok place listing for Troy Lookout Tower came up in search with a claim of a 1941 USFS build and 70 ft height; the page could not be read, so the claim is not used. Anyplace America's Troy tower page returned HTTP 403. The brief's status unknown and access unknown stand. Possible next step: NC Forest Service photo records or a Montgomery County historical source.
